destination-winery-vineyard.display: Destination Winery / Vineyard with Event Program
tech_signals: WineDirect or Commerce7 (DTC wine club platform)
The Knot or WeddingWire wedding-venue listing
Tock or Resy tasting-room reservation system
Active Instagram or Pinterest account with property/event photography
intent_signals: Recently posted harvest festival, vintner's dinner, or club-pickup event on social
Listed on a regional wine trail association website
The Knot / WeddingWire wedding-venue listing created or updated in last 12 months
Job posting for Events Director, Hospitality Manager, or Tasting Room Manager
Advertising extended evening tasting hours or holiday programming
exclusions: Production-only wineries / vineyards without a public tasting room
Properties without outdoor event space or patio
Properties with fewer than an estimated 25K annual visitors (insufficient event volume)
National chain / franchise hospitality groups (not owner-operated — procurement more formal)

regional-brewery-with-event-space.display: Regional Craft Brewery / Taproom with Event Space
tech_signals: Eventbrite or Tock event listings for release nights or taproom events
Active Facebook Events or Instagram event stories for Oktoberfest / seasonal programming
Untappd brewery profile with taproom check-ins
intent_signals: Recently posted Oktoberfest, harvest-release, or mug-club event on social
Eventbrite or ticketing page for a fall or holiday event in the last 12 months
Job posting for Taproom Manager or Events Coordinator
Listed as a private-event venue on local-venue directories
Advertising a mug club, beer club, or release-night membership program
exclusions: Production-only / distribution-focused breweries without a public taproom
Taprooms without dedicated outdoor space or event-capacity infrastructure
Nano-breweries / homebrew-scale operations (insufficient event volume to justify install)
